data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for launching URLs across mobile, desktop, and web platforms.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that launches URLs for web browsers, phone calls, SMS messages, and emails. It supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
use_when: You need to open external web links in a browser or in-app view.
You want to trigger phone calls, SMS messages, or emails using native apps.
You need to open local files on desktop platforms using standard file associations.
avoid_when: You need an embedded web view widget displayed natively inside your widget tree instead of launching an external browser or overlay.
You need complex in-app web browsing capabilities beyond basic custom tabs or browser launching.
strengths: Supports a wide range of platforms (Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, Linux).
Handles common URI schemes like http, https, mailto, tel, sms, and file.
Provides flexibility for launch modes and browser configurations.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration such as query schemes on iOS and intent queries on Android for checking link support.
Platform support depends on installed applications on the host device.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding URL schemes to Info.plist on iOS and intent queries to AndroidManifest.xml for proper canLaunchUrl and launch behavior.
